projects.title: FreeEdit
projects.description: A browser-based editor for shaping screen recordings and polishing their sound, captions, and visual details.
highlights: Edit screen recordings on a visual timeline with captions, annotations, privacy masks, and zoom effects.
Process audio and video with configurable noise reduction, pause shortening, and export options.
Save edit projects for later and review short previews before exporting.

projects.title: Repository LLD Generator
projects.description: Understand unfamiliar Java codebases faster with UML diagrams generated from their source structure.
highlights: Parses Java source code to identify classes, interfaces, methods, fields, and inheritance relationships.
Generates PlantUML diagrams for repositories, modules, and subdirectories.
Provides a web interface to preview diagrams for public GitHub and GitLab repositories.

projects.title: DevFolioX
projects.description: Build and publish tailored developer portfolios from a profile you manage in one place.
highlights: Import a resume and GitHub projects into an editable portfolio workspace.
Create multiple targeted portfolio variants using the same shared profile.
Publish responsive portfolios and review first-party engagement analytics.

projects.title: Evalcue AI
projects.description: An interview practice and assessment platform for candidates and teams that need consistent, evidence-based feedback.
highlights: Supports role-specific practice and candidate assessments across voice, coding, system design, and multi-file debugging workflows.
Provides hiring pipelines, weighted scorecards, evidence review, and human calibration controls.
Uses Redis and BullMQ for asynchronous evaluation, with billing, observability, and production deployment safeguards.

projects.title: YAML Data Visualizer
projects.description: Explore large YAML files visually, compare changes, and collaborate on configurations without getting lost in nested structures.
highlights: Renders more than 5,000 nodes at 60fps using virtual rendering and frame scheduling.
Supports real-time collaboration, delta-based versioning, diff comparison, and secure GitHub webhook integrations.
Recent work improved diff correctness and added regression coverage to CI for the comparison workflow.

projects.title: Chess ML Coach
projects.description: A chess coach that analyzes your games, identifies recurring mistakes, and creates personalized practice with Stockfish and machine learning.
highlights: Runs Stockfish analysis in the browser for hosted workflows, with resumable checkpoints and shared analysis coordination.
Uses authenticated, isolated player data with PostgreSQL-backed persistence and adaptive spaced-repetition practice.
Combines engine-grounded coaching with player-specific modelling to identify mistake-prone positions and generate personal training.

projects.title: Ecommerce Search Engine
projects.description: An e-commerce search engine combining full-text retrieval, caching, and machine-learning-based ranking for more relevant product results.
highlights: Uses PostgreSQL full-text retrieval, Redis query/result caches, and cursor-based pagination for low-latency search.
Ranks results with LightGBM using popularity, relevance, freshness, category, price, and interaction features.
Includes personalization, event tracking, background retraining, and an A/B framework for ranking experiments.

projects.title: ExitSense
projects.description: An Android app that detects when you're leaving home and reminds you what to bring, using device sensors rather than GPS.

projects.title: Developer Knowledge Base
projects.description: Organize technical notes, coding questions, and solutions in nested workspaces with Markdown editing, search, and optional AI assistance.
highlights: Supports Notion-style nested workspaces, drag-and-drop organization, pinned notes, favorites, and multiple solutions.
Combines a Markdown editor, live preview, syntax highlighting, and global search.
Provides per-user Supabase-authenticated workspaces and OpenAI-powered answer generation.

projects.title: MERN Chat Application
projects.description: A real-time messaging app with user accounts, JWT authentication, and Socket.IO-powered conversations.

projects.title: Hackathon Portal
projects.description: Manage hackathon teams, ideas, submissions, judging, and event workflows in one application.
highlights: Designed a role-based access-control system spanning six roles.
Automated evaluation workflows using AI APIs.
Managed teams, submissions, ideas, participants, and scoring through the event lifecycle.

projects.title: Store Management System
projects.description: Track inventory, sales, and basic reports through a lightweight store management interface.

projects.title: Kanban Board
projects.description: A drag-and-drop board for organizing tasks and tracking work across stages.

projects.title: Notes Application
projects.description: Create, edit, search, and organize notes with Markdown support.

projects.title: Quiz Application
projects.description: Take category-based quizzes, receive scores, and review results.

projects.title: Tic Tac Toe Game
projects.description: Play tic-tac-toe against a computer opponent or another player, with score tracking.

projects.title: Dictionary Application
projects.description: Look up definitions, pronunciations, and examples through a dictionary API.

projects.title: Flappy Bird Game
projects.description: A browser-based Flappy Bird recreation with responsive controls and score tracking.

projects.title: Codeforces Filter
projects.description: A Chrome extension that filters Codeforces blog activity by user rating and other criteria.

projects.title: India Startup Map
projects.description: Explore Indian startups by city, sector, hiring status, and technology stack using source-linked location data.
highlights: Explore city and company listings through an interactive map.
Filter organizations by sector and hiring details.
Keep uncertainty visible through source-linked records and location confidence rules.

projects.title: Kindred Code
projects.description: Find developers with similar interests using public GitHub activity, ranked matching, and rate-aware discovery.
highlights: Discover developers from public GitHub signals.
Rank shared interests and account for API rate limits.

projects.title: PR Blast Radius
projects.description: Analyze potential production impact of Java/Spring Boot pull requests using static code evidence, PostgreSQL dependencies, and OpenTelemetry traces.
highlights: Inspect changed Java endpoints and types using source-aware static analysis.
Correlate PostgreSQL schema and runtime dependency evidence.
Report findings with explicit evidence strength and coverage warnings.

projects.title: RecallLater
projects.description: A local-first mobile inbox for screenshots, PDFs, links, and text, with on-device extraction and reminders.
highlights: Collect shared content into device-private storage.
Extract details on-device and schedule local reminders.

projects.title: NEET
projects.description: An Android exam preparation app with adaptive practice, mock tests, flashcards, and optional cloud synchronization.
